claims.claim_ar: حرف الاستدراك «بل» يدخل لردّ الافتراض السابق وتصحيح الحكم؛ هنا يُنقَل الاتهام عن الإخوة إلى نَفْسٍ مُضَلَّةٍ، فيظهر المقصد بالتبرئة والتصويب.
claims.claim_en: The corrective particle «بَل» is used to refute the prior implication and correct the judgment; here it shifts the blame from the brothers to a misleading inner impulse, thereby exonerating and correcting the prior accusation.
claims.needs_review_reason: The particle «بل» may be analysed variously (simple negation, strong correction, or iltifat). Classification here as corrective/contrastive fits the Kashshāf citation but could be refined with additional rhetorical sources.

claims.claim_ar: تُشخَّصُ النُّفُوسُ هنا بصيغة فاعلية («سَوَّلَتْ»)؛ أيْ تُنسب إليها القدرة على الإيقاع بالمرء، وهذا تجسيد للنفس وتشبيه ضمني يجعلها طرفاً فاعلاً في الفعل.
claims.claim_en: The souls are personified here by attributing an active verb («sawwalat») to them; the inner selves are depicted as capable of instigating action — a personification/metaphorical portrayal that shifts responsibility to inner impulse.

warnings: Provided source chunks are only from Zamakhsharī (al-Kashshaf). No excerpts from al-Jurjānī, al-Sakkākī, al-Baqillānī, al-Suyūṭī, or specialised tafsir-balagha were supplied; rhetorical claims may therefore be incomplete.

Several phrases of the aya (e.g. «فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسَى اللَّهُ... إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ») do not appear in the supplied chunks, so devices relating to those segments could not be checked against source quotes and were omitted.
